certification.rationale: Highest-ranked available source is tier 2 (Corporate fact sheet, or non-financial annual or regulatory report), as of 2024-12-31, reporting 513. 0 independent corroborating source(s) within 15%. Confidence 3 (Supported).

notes: Form 990 filings found on ProPublica (EIN 943062436).

Form 990 line 5 counts (already recorded) are the only company-filed figures. They run above point-in-time counts because line 5 includes anyone issued a W-2 during the year. Trend: 438 (2020), 449, 475, 518 (2023), 513 (2024). LinkedIn member counts (331, 338, 341) are all undated; 341 is the newest by follower count. No LinkedIn growth data was found. Excluded: website '15 employees' (first-year staff of predecessor CTDN, historical), '13 million people' and '100,000 people' (service population), RocketReach 8 employees (not whole organization), and size ranges only from ZoomInfo, Crunchbase, Glassdoor, Indeed and LeadIQ (201-500 or 251-500). Cause IQ's 513 restates the Form 990 and is not independent. Open job postings (34 per Revelio, 43 per LinkedIn) are ordinary recruiting, not an event.
